900.3.10(1461).explanation: Exception RD 1461 keeps the lot frontage and lot area that existed when By-law 569-2013 was enacted, sets side setbacks of 0.9 m (3.6 m next to a street), allows the part of a building with a parking space in a side yard at 0.45 m from the side lot line, sets a 22.0 m centreline setback along Warden Ave. and Pharmacy Ave., and keeps former Scarborough by-law 9511 for 32 and 34 Guild Hall Dr.

900.3.10(812).explanation: Exception RD 812 keeps the lot frontage and lot area that existed when By-law 569-2013 was enacted, sets a 0.9 m side setback (4.5 m next to a street, 0.3 m for an attached garage), front setbacks of 7.5 m on Middlefield Rd. and McNicoll Ave., 4.5 m on listed lots and 6.0 m otherwise, requires the parking space in the residential building, and also requires compliance with exception 900.3.10(1462).
